EventBus.shared.publisher.receive(on: DispatchQueue.main).sink { [weak self] event in guard let self else { return } switch event { case.nextPOIRequested: print("[VirtualGuide] nextPOIRequested — deteniendo video actual y limpiando cola") self.currentPOIVideoCompleted = false self.clearQueueAndStop() case.tourEndRequested: print("[VirtualGuide] tourEndRequested — reproduciendo despedida") self.playDespedida() default: break } }.store

AppStateManager.shared.$currentState.receive(on: DispatchQueue.main).sink { [weak self] state in guard let self else { return } if case.inTour = state, self.hasStartedWalking { print("[VirtualGuide] AppState ->.inTour — startWalking()") self.startWalking() } }.store
